title: UniSwap Curve Simulator
description: Dive into the world of decentralized finance with this interactive UniSwap Curve Simulator 🌊! It vividly demonstrates the core constant product formula of UniSwap's Automated Market Maker (AMM): x * y = k, where x and y represent the reserves of two tokens (like Token A and Token B), and k remains constant to maintain liquidity balance 💧. Users can dynamically adjust initial reserves—starting from balanced 1.00 A and 1.00 B setups—and simulate trades by inputting buy or sell amounts to see real-time impacts on prices, slippage, and pool dynamics 📊. Perfect for DeFi enthusiasts, traders, and developers, this tool illuminates how liquidity provision works without order books, highlighting risks like impermanent loss and the benefits of efficient token swaps ⚡. Explore scenarios from small trades to large imbalances, gaining insights into optimizing yield farming and understanding market volatility in Ethereum-based exchanges. Whether you're a beginner grasping AMM basics or an expert tweaking strategies, this simulator offers hands-on learning to demystify one of crypto's foundational innovations 🚀, fostering a deeper appreciation for sustainable decentralized trading ecosystems.
